title: Kane ends England’s 25-year wait to win men’s Ballon d’Or award
description: Harry Kane becomes the first English player to win the prize since Michael Owen in 2001, and Spain midfielder Alexia Putellas wins the Ballon d’Or Feminin for a record-equalling third time.

title: Chris Mason: Budget is imminent as tricky issues pile up for Burnham
description: From Brexit debates to North Sea oil, there is plenty getting the cabinet, the Labour Party and the country talking.

title: Chancellor to cut tariffs on some staple goods to offer cost of living help
description: The chancellor will axe tariffs on some staples as part of plans to give households "breathing space".

title: Israel and the US are both going to the polls - the consequences will be global
description: The next fortnight sees two elections on different continents. The outcomes will shape geopolitics and the global economy, writes James Landale

title: Trump administration illegally fired James Comey's daughter, judge rules
description: Maurene Comey believes she was let go from her job as a federal prosecutor because her father is the former FBI director.

title: Storm Boelo leaves 22,000 without power as Met Office issues new wind warning
description: A yellow warning for strong winds came in effect at 18:00 on Monday across the west coast of England, Wales and Scotland and eastern parts of Northern Ireland.

title: Jay-Z to perform at Super Bowl half-time show
description: Jay-Z has been involved with the show for years but has never before performed at the NFL championship game.

title: Truce begins in wartorn Ukraine city after it was announced by Melania Trump
